# Duckpad 0.18.3
Find/Replace in Files keeps results and their preview visible while a new query is being typed and searched. Previously, each edit cleared both views twice, causing a blank flash. Old results cannot activate or replace anything while the next query is pending. Empty final results and errors clear the view, and late preview responses cannot restore results after a failure. Repeated or growing progress preserves the selected match and preview text selection.
Multi-root searches share the remaining file-count and input-byte budgets across roots that have not started. A large earlier project can no longer consume the whole 10,000-file/256-MiB allowance before later projects are visited. This fixes missing later-root matches such as `hongyoung` in a configuration URL. Unused capacity carries forward; earlier roots can remain partial even if later roots leave spare capacity. Truncation stays visible and disables Replace All. Global file, byte, match and result-memory bounds remain in force.
When **Share usage statistics** is enabled, bounded background batches can also use metered and Low Data Mode connections. Previously, those network restrictions could produce an offline error even while the collection API was reachable. Turning sharing off still cancels delivery and clears queued counters. Existing timeouts, batch/request limits, ephemeral sessions and redirect rejection remain. The statistics service's database memory limits were repaired separately. Earlier missing events may remain absent; the fix does not fabricate historical activity.
## Compatibility and installation
The app and all three helpers are **0.18.3 (74)**, upgrading **0.18.2 (73)**. Requires macOS 13 or later; the universal app includes Apple Silicon and Intel. Host API **1.6.0**, native ABI v1 and independently released plugins are unchanged. No runtime dependencies were added or upgraded.
Download `Duckpad-0.18.3-universal.dmg` or `Duckpad-0.18.3-universal.zip` and verify against `SHA256SUMS.txt`. After the tap update, Homebrew installations can run:
```sh brew update brew upgrade --cask --greedy namjeongwan/duckpad/duckpad ```
Existing installations can use **Check for Updates** after the signed feed is published. Distribution is ad-hoc signed, without Developer ID signing or Apple notarization.
## Validation and limits
Search validation passed **42 focused test functions**, including five new UI regressions, file/byte fairness variants, native unsaved-buffer searching, stale actions, streamed progress, replacement boundaries and simulated Korean input. Before the fixes, the flicker and both later-root fairness cases fail. Search scope methods passed in isolated processes; combined-suite completion was not verified. User documents were not modified by these tests.
An additional **13 statistics tests** passed. The unchanged native transport reproduced an offline failure on the current restricted connection; the fixed transport sent a Debug diagnostic through the public endpoint, and its exact record was verified in ClickHouse. Debug records are separate from Release usage. The opt-in `scripts/smoke_usage_statistics.swift` repeats this check without opening user sessions or changing preferences. Live Release-user ingestion and the authenticated dashboard UI are not claimed as tested by this diagnostic.
The universal release app was rebuilt from clean merged main commit `8783ad4fee075cee903e21474d8c13fb913f6dff`. Bundle/signature/resources, app and all three helper versions/architectures, default app smokes, all eight packaged locales and DMG/ZIP integrity passed. Packaged Markdown resources retain the earlier caret fix. A Debug diagnostic using the packaged 0.18.3 configuration also sent successfully through the native Swift transport and was verified in the database exactly once.
Intel hardware, macOS 13 runtime, physical Korean IME and a full repository suite are not claimed. Optional native Save-panel automation was skipped.
